gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 sterile-site specimen value set is unavailable; generic and unrestricted test-name branches requiring a separate sterile-site specimen criterion are omitted from LIS-R3, LIS-R4, and LIS-R8 while sterile-site-specific test-name alternatives remain modeled

the source explicitly marks rules 5 through 7 inoperable because maternal-neonatal linkage and related specimen timing cannot be evaluated; SEM_V1 has no cross-patient epidemiologic-link predicate, so these rules are omitted entirely rather than allowing age or compatible neonatal illness to report alone
